attempts.certificate: 1) “不一定下雨”可写为 $!p，且由(4)等价于 !#p。2) 先合取/析取括号再加模态，分别为 $(p-!p) 与 #(p>q)。3) “必然运行”与“可能不运行”满足A的 #p 与 $!p；两者均为可能分别满足C的 $p 与 $!p。4) #!p→!#p 对应(6)。5) 由(9) #p→$p，因此选A。

judges.reason: All five outputs match the stated modal notation and rules: $!p expresses that rain is not necessary; the two symbolizations correctly apply the modal operator outside the parenthesized proposition; the relation pairs match A and C; formula (6) is #!p → !#p; and formula (9) yields #p → $p, so A.
judges.depth_evidence: The solution requires translating negated modality using the given equivalence, constructing parenthesized conjunction/disjunction or implication before applying a modal operator, matching modal conjunctions to relation definitions, and instantiating the listed implication formulas.
judges.explanation_evidence: The certificate explicitly checks each of the five answers and its checks agree with the definitions and numbered formulas. In particular, it identifies $!p with !#p via (4), matches A and C by their defining conjunctions, applies (6) to #!p, and applies (9) to #p.
